name: Bun rieu tom
summary: Bún riêu tôm is Vung Tau’s shrimp bowl. Vietnam Tourism contrasts it with inland crab bún riêu: shrimp stock, tomato, herbs, shrimp cakes, tofu, squid, and pork, with greens and shrimp paste on the side.
origin: Vung Tau, on Vietnam Tourism’s local-eating article. A street was not printed.
taste: Vietnam Tourism says the shrimp stock is naturally sweet, with tangy tomato and herbs. Shrimp paste stays on the side.
howToEat: Put the greens in the bowl. Add the shrimp paste only if you want it.
A street, an hour, and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Vung Tau. Vietnam Tourism does not name a street. Check on arrival.
